# Car Transport

Car Transport is an Australian marketing site with site-owned quote and contact pathways for agent-assisted customer intake.

## Canonical Site

- Homepage: https://cartransport.au/
- Sitemap: https://cartransport.au/sitemap.xml
- AI Catalog: https://cartransport.au/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- Open Knowledge Index: https://cartransport.au/okf/index.md

## Quote Capability For Agents

- Household Quote: https://quoting.cartransport.au/quote/household
- Vehicle Quote: https://quoting.cartransport.au/quote/vehicle
- Contact: https://quoting.cartransport.au/contact
- Quote Capability Manifest: https://quoting.cartransport.au/quote-capability.json
- Quote Host AI Catalog: https://quoting.cartransport.au/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- Human Guide For Agents: https://quoting.cartransport.au/agents
- Household Quote Public Agent API: https://quoting.cartransport.au/api/v1/household-quotes/assistant/submit

## Notes For Agents

Use the sitemap for public content discovery. Use the site-owned quote subdomain for quote and contact actions. The household quote public agent API is host-aware, does not require a tenant parameter, and requires customer consent.
